item.title: Federal Bank Regulatory Agencies Release 2025 Small Business, Small Farm, and Community Development Lending Data
item.description:
Federal Bank Regulatory Agencies Release 2025 Small Business, Small Farm, and Community Development Lending Data
The federal bank regulatory agencies, as members of the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), today released data on small business, small farm, and community development lending during 2025. The Community Reinvestment Act regulations require the agencies to annually disclose these data.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.category: Community Reinvestment Act (CRA), Rural Economic Development, Small Business
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Raises Concerns with California's Climate Disclosure Laws
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today submitted a letter to the California Air Resource Board (CARB) addressing the serious legal and policy concerns raised by two California climate disclosure laws.

item.title: OCC Releases Report on Large Banks’ Debanking Activities
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today released a report of its findings from its supervisory review of debanking activities at the nine largest national banks it supervises: JPMorgan Chase Bank, Bank of America, Citibank, Wells Fargo Bank, U.S. Bank, Capital One, PNC Bank, TD Bank, and BMO Bank.

item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

item.title: OCC Imposes $750 Million Assessment Against Bank of America for Deficient BSA/AML Compliance
item.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) today announced a $750 million civil money penalty against Bank of America, N.A. (bank), for violations of the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations, including 12 CFR 21.21 and 12 CFR 21.11. This amount is the largest in OCC history.
item.author: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
item.source: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency
